title: A positive test is not the whole story

scenes.title: Count both kinds of positive result
scenes.narration: A positive test can come from someone with the condition, or from someone without it. To interpret the test, we must count both paths.

visual.caption: A test result is evidence, not certainty.

scenes.title: Compare the true and false positives
scenes.narration: In an illustrative group, nine true positives and about fifty false positives produce only a fifteen percent chance of the condition after a positive result.
